narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>It grows every day, so it is five to the power forty bottles.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Each day brings only one more container of five bottles.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Nothing is multiplied by five again and again, so no power appears here.

<bookmark mark='m2'/>Each day adds five, so day ten gives fifty, and day forty gives four times that.
